Title: RGM Pricing Strategy Executive
Description: BAT is evolving at pace into a global multi-category business. With products like VELO, VUSE and GLO we are on a mission to decrease the health impact of our industry To achieve our ambition, we are looking for colleagues who are ready to Be The Change. Come, join us on this journey! British American Tobacco Mexico has an exciting opportunity for a RGM Pricing Strategy Executive in Heredia, Costa Rica. The Pricing Strategy Executive will work alongside its US and MX colleagues to develop tools that help shape the company’s Pricing (Investment/Discounting) Strategy to deliver the company’s objectives. The ideal candidate has a strong technical background and wants to leverage these capabilities to produce business-focused deliverables. A strong interest in learning the commercial and financial reasoning behind business strategies is desired. Your Key Responsibilities Will Include Support & develop analysis using commercial, consumer, & financial data (Databricks / PySpark), integrating consumer, commercial, and financial data. Reinforce the transition of Excel-based workflows into Databricks and Power BI. Build automated pricing and performance reporting through scalable data models, DAX measures, and DirectQuery connections to enable timely decision-making across the team. Assist in scenario modelling for quarterly promotion planning, incorporate what-if simulations, and constrained optimization to balance margin, volume, and compliance trade-offs. Work regularly with U.S stakeholders to align on business assumptions, document methodologies, and support automation opportunities across teams. Support deployment of models and pipelines using Databricks Workflows/Jobs, Delta Live Tables, and robust data validation frameworks to ensure production-grade reliability. What are we looking for? Bachelor's Degree required, Economics, Finance, Mathematics, Computer Science or Engineering preferred. 1 to 2 years of professional experience, at least 1+ years in data science / engineering, revenue management, pricing, with emphasis on FMCGs is desirable. Experience in process automation & analysis of large-scale data sets. Familiarity with basic machine learning frameworks (regression / decision trees) preferred. Use of data visualization platforms and development of dashboards & data models (Tableau, Power BI) is desirable. Fluent in English, written and spoken. Time management skills with an ability to adhere to strict deadlines and deliverables. Ability to communicate technical information in a consolidated and straightforward way. Ability to manage multiple stakeholders both virtually and physically in the office. Be able to design independently and deliver E2E analytics solutions / outcomes per specification. Proficiency using Databricks, and the ability to quickly learn and use cloud-based third-party applications. What we offer you? We offer a market leading annual performance bonus (subject to eligibility) Our range of benefits varies by country and includes diverse health plans, initiatives for work-life balance, transportation support, and a flexible holiday plan with additional incentives Your journey with us isn't limited by boundaries; it's propelled by your aspirations. Join us at BAT and become a part of an environment that thrives on internal advancement, where your career progression isn't just a statement – it's a reality we're eager to build together. Seize the opportunity and own your development; your next chapter starts here. You'll have access to online learning platforms and personalized growth programs to nurture your leadership skills We prioritise continuous improvement within a transformative environment, preparing for ongoing changes WHY JOIN BAT? We’re one of the few companies named as a Global Top Employer by the Top Employers Institute – certified in offering excellent employee conditions. Collaboration, inclusion and partnership underpin everything we do here at BAT. We are looking forward to enabling every individual to thrive, regardless of gender, sexual orientation, marital or civil partnership status, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, skills, experience, education, socio-economic and professional background, veteran status, perspectives and thinking styles. We know that embracing talent from all backgrounds is what makes us stronger and best prepared to meet our business goals. We see the career breaks as opportunities not obstacles. Through The Global Returners program, we support professionals looking to restart their careers after an extended absence from the workforce (e.g. time out caring for family, parental leave, national service, sabbatical and/or starting an own venture). Come bring your difference and see what is possible for you at BAT. Learn more about our culture and our award winning employee experience here . If you require any reasonable adjustments or accommodations to help you perform at your best during the recruitment process, you are encouraged to notify us. We are fully committed to support you by making appropriate arrangements for you to demonstrate your full potential.

Title: Consumer Risk Sr. Representative
Description: Job Description ¿Por qué GM Financial? GM Financial es la subsidiaria financiera cautiva, de propiedad total, de General Motors y tiene su sede en Fort Worth, Estados Unidos. Somos un proveedor global de soluciones de financiamiento automotriz, con operaciones en América del Norte, América del Sur y la región de Asia-Pacífico. A través de nuestras relaciones de larga trayectoria con concesionarios de automóviles, ofrecemos atractivas opciones de financiamiento minorista y programas de leasing para atender las necesidades específicas de cada cliente. También ofrecemos productos de crédito comercial a concesionarios para ayudarlos a financiar y hacer crecer sus negocios. En GM Financial, los miembros de nuestro equipo definen y dan forma a nuestra cultura: un entorno que da la bienvenida a nuevas ideas, fomenta la integridad y crea un sentido de comunidad y pertenencia. Aquí hacemos más que trabajar: prosperamos. Nuestro propósito: Impulsamos las innovaciones que mueven y conectan a las personas con lo que importa. This position will be posted until filled. Review consumer portfolio trends, transforming data analysis into recommendations to the business senior management. Regulatory reserves calculation and support with audit or regulatory requirements. Creation and maintenance of models to forecast the behavior of the portfolio. Support on the development of credit policies. Fluent English Skills. Analytical mindset. Effective oral and written communication. Previous experience on portfolio reporting, credit analysis, credit strategy development, statistical modelling. Title: Data Analyst
Description: KEMET de México , with over a century of experience, is a global leader in the design and manufacturing of multilayer ceramic capacitors that power tomorrow’s technologies. We are recognized for our unwavering commitment to quality, reliability, and advanced solutions that meet the rigorous demands of a wide range of industries. We offer solutions based on advanced materials science and cutting-edge manufacturing, ensuring maximum performance and sustainability. As part of the YAGEO Group Company , KEMET leverages shared expertise and resources to drive innovation in the electronics industry. As a Data Analyst you will play a critical support role within the Global Distribution G7 team, ensuring smooth operational execution, data accuracy, and proactive coordination with internal and external stakeholders. This position supports the Distribution Director and Account Managers by managing administrative tasks, preparing reports, and facilitating communication across departments. This is a full-time, on-site position located at our Monterrey, NL offices. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in business administration, international business, international relations, communication or related field. 3+ years' experience in sales or customer service. Responsibilities Assist in managing distributor accounts by preparing sales reports, tracking agreed KPIs reporting, and maintaining CRM data. Communicate and monitor general issues with G7 team like order entry, pricing, logistic issues, etc. Support the distribution programs and campaigns (invoice follow-up, SFDC monitoring/budget, assist with events & sales promotions). Compile and analyze sales data to support forecasting and performance reviews with sales regions/distributor. Act as a liaison between the Distribution Account Manager and internal teams (SBG, PBUs, Finance, Logistics). Facilitate & consolidate communication with distributors regarding updates, lead times, PCN, etc… Qualifications and Skills Advanced English level. Strong organizational and multitasking skills. Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook). Power BI and SalesForce. Detail-oriented with a proactive mindset. We Offer Collaboration in an international environment with strong recognition of people and talent. A pleasant and people-centered work environment, with a highly motivated team where you can showcase your skills and dedication. Training and continuous learning opportunities. A comprehensive benefits package above legal requirements. About YAGEO Group We don’t make the final product. We make what makes it possible. From resistors to capacitors, inductors to sensors, our components drive the advancements that move the modern world—electric vehicles, AI data centers, satellites, sonar systems, and many more. They move faster, last longer, go farther—with a spark of us inside. Headquartered in Taiwan, YAGEO Group brings together multiple trusted brands, including YAGEO, KEMET, PULSE, and Telemecanique Sensors, among others, into a cohesive force for innovation. Over 40,000 employees. Over 100 locations. 20 R&D centers. Over 2,000 patents. More than 273,000 customers. #1 in resistors and tantalum capacitors. #3 in MLCCs and inductors. We don’t just participate in the future—we make it possible. Why work at KEMET, a YAGEO Group Company? Meaningful work : Every component you help design, test, or improve contributes to real innovations. Global exposure : Collaborate across continents, brands, and cutting-edge technologies. Accelerated growth : Our size, diversity, and drive mean there are no limits to your potential. Integrated purpose : You’re not just part of the process—you’re part of the progress. YAGEO Group. Built for the future. Title: Ingeniero de IA y TI (AI & IT Engineer)
Description: Estamos buscando a un Ingeniero de IA y TI basado en México Monterrey que quiera tomar el control de nuestra infraestructura tecnológica y transformarla utilizando Inteligencia Artificial avanzada. No buscamos a un administrador de sistemas tradicional. Buscamos a un constructor. Alguien que vea un proceso manual repetitivo y sienta la necesidad física de automatizarlo con código o IA. Lo que harás con nosotros: Diseñar, desarrollar e integrar soluciones de IA (LLMs, agentes autónomos, embeddings) en nuestros flujos de trabajo diarios. Optimizar y asegurar nuestra infraestructura tecnológica (TI, bases de datos, herramientas en la nube) para que el negocio escale sin fricción. Conectar sistemas dispersos mediante APIs y plataformas de automatización avanzada. Eliminar el trabajo aburrido y manual de todo nuestro equipo mediante tecnología. Lo que necesitas para ganar el puesto: Dominio real: Experiencia demostrable programando en Python y trabajando con APIs de modelos de lenguaje (OpenAI, Claude, etc.). Mentalidad de solucionador: Si algo se rompe, encuentras la causa raíz y la arreglas de forma permanente. No pones parches temporales. Autonomía brutal: No tenemos tiempo para microgestionar. Te daremos el objetivo y los recursos; tú descifras el "cómo". Ubicación: México Monterrey Hibrido 3x2 Lo que ofrecemos: Pago competitivo en base a habilidades y resultados. Entorno de alta velocidad donde tus ideas se implementan en días, no en meses. Cero burocracia corporativa. CÓMO APLICAR (Lee con atención): No envíes solo tu CV genérico. Si quieres que revisemos tu perfil, responde a este anuncio incluyendo un enlace a tu GitHub, portafolio o un breve párrafo que explique la automatización o sistema de IA más complejo que hayas construido por tu cuenta y qué impacto tuvo. Si no incluyes esto, asumiremos que no lees los detalles y tu postulación será descartada automáticamente.
